edges.reason: _transfer reads _buyMap[buyer] against block.timestamp to pick the punitive sell tax.
_transfer writes the _feeAddr1 tax numerator before computing values.
_transfer writes the _feeAddr2 tax numerator (1%/25% penalty or 14%).
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call before _tokenTransfer updates balances.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out before the balance state updates in _tokenTransfer.
_transfer always ends by delegating to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer uses _isBuy(uniswapV2Pair) to distinguish buys from sells.
_transfer reads and writes cooldown[to] with block.timestamp based expiry.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on pair buys.
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to] to block blacklisted addresses.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to authorize the router to spend contract tokens.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap which transfers control to an untrusted contract.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router to call WETH() and the swap function.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet1 via transfer.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH to _feeAddrWallet2 via transfer.
sendETHToFee uses the stored _feeAddrWallet1 recipient.
sendETHToFee uses the stored _feeAddrWallet2 recipient.
openTrading calls createPair on the Uniswap factory.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading stores the router address into uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair into uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading enables cooldownEnabled.
openTrading sets tradingOpen; the require(!tradingOpen) gate is the only access control besides onlyOwner.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth, which performs an external router call.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee, which pushes ETH to external wallets.
transfer forwards msg.sender/recipient/amount to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender/recipient/amount to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
approve calls _approve to write the allowance mapping.
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist mapping.
delBot writes false into the bots blacklist mapping.
updateMaxTx writes _maxTxAmount, changing transfer limits.
setMaxTx writes _maxTxAmount, changing transfer limits.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldown enforcement flag.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with reflection and token fees.
_transferStandard reads all computed values from _getValues.
_transferStandard subtracts/adds _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee using SafeMath sub/add.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues obtains the currentRate from _getRate.
_getValues passes the stored _feeAddr1 tax numerator into _getTValues.
_getValues passes the stored _feeAddr2 tax numerator into _getTValues.
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides rAmount by the rate returned from _getRate.
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads _rOwned[account].
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited source account.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender and decrements its allowance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorizes solely by require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1).
manualsend authorizes solely by require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1).
_transfer tax, cooldown and _buyMap logic depend on block.timestamp.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
The external router swap is reachable from _transfer before _tokenTransfer updates balances; control can return to a malicious pair/router before state settlement.
manualswap reaches the external router swap call directly, allowing callback into the contract.
ETH push to fee wallet 1 is an external callback point reached before related accounting completes.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner, removing the onlyOwner gate permanently.

amount is consumed only by transfer.

recipient is consumed only by transferFrom.
amount is consumed only by transferFrom.

amount is the second parameter of approve.
bots_ is the blacklist array parameter of setBots.
i is the iteration index local to setBots.
notbot is the only parameter of delBot.
onoff is the only parameter of setCooldownEnabled.
local router instance is only used inside openTrading.
account is the only parameter of balanceOf.
rAmount is the only parameter of tokenFromReflection.
owner is the allowance owner parameter of _approve.
spender is the allowance spender parameter of _approve.
amount is the allowance value parameter of _approve.
sender is the source parameter of _tokenTransfer.
recipient is the destination parameter of _tokenTransfer.
amount is the value parameter of _tokenTransfer.
tAmount is the only parameter of _transferStandard.
tAmount is the only parameter of _getValues.
tAmount is the token amount parameter of _getTValues.
taxFee is the first tax numerator parameter of _getTValues.
TeamFee is the second tax numerator parameter of _getTValues.
currentRate is a conversion parameter of _getRValues.
